automated_attribute_screen.boundary: Name, pattern, length, missingness, cardinality, and current-role screening cannot replace contextual human review.

downstream_utility_decision.rationale: The current result is an anonymization and disclosure-metric study. It explicitly makes no claim that predictive or clinical task utility is preserved. A utility experiment needs a named downstream outcome, task, split protocol, metrics, and acceptable degradation threshold.
reopen_if: the release is proposed for a defined predictive or clinical task
the project claims downstream machine-learning utility preservation
the data custodian specifies a task-specific utility requirement

experiment_scope_decision.rationale: The current claims are bounded to the predeclared one-factor study, the four-candidate multi-seed robustness study, and the held-out candidate. They do not claim an exhaustive grid search or a global parameter optimum. Running the remaining 181 points would be a new exploratory study, not validation required by the current claims.
reopen_if: a claim of exhaustive Appendix A grid coverage is proposed
a claim of globally best PRTI-GH hyperparameters is proposed
a reviewer or preregistered follow-up protocol requires the full grid

release_gates.gate: data custodian threat model and intended recipient
clinical review of all 106 attribute roles
privacy and data-governance review of all 106 roles
